meta.title: 大厂口才进化论：第一年说人话，第五年讲黑话
meta.title_en: How Big-Tech Talk Evolves: From Plain Words to Jargon

scenes.context: 第一年的新人把「加对外宣传」的需求讲得简单清楚，两天就能交付。
sentences: 咱们公司这个活动方案需要增加对外宣传这部分的内容，你看能不能加进去。
Our event plan needs more external promotion — can you add it in?
对外宣传：external promotion
只要针对目标客户群策划好宣传内容，然后选择合适的媒体做发布就可以了。
Just plan content for our target audience and pick the right channels to publish it.
目标客户群：target audience
我加加班，明天下班前交给你。
I'll put in some extra hours and have it to you before tomorrow's end of day.
加加班：put in extra hours
paraphrase: 人话 = 做什么 + 怎么做 + 何时交付
Plain talk = what, how, and when.
The newbie wins by keeping it simple.
scenes.speak: Our event plan needs more external promotion — can you add it in? Just plan content for our target audience and pick the right channels to publish it. I'll put in some extra hours and have it to you before tomorrow's end of day.

scenes.context: 同一类需求被包装成数字化转型、战略合力、信息透传等战略级黑话。
sentences: 线下活动和线上宣传必须把目标拉起，各个部门都要拉通信息、强化协同。
Offline events and online promotion must align on goals; every department needs to share information and strengthen collaboration.
拉通信息：share information
顶层设计是聚焦用户的感知赛道，底层逻辑是针对用户痛点做归因分析。
The top-level design zeroes in on the user's perception track; the underlying logic runs attribution analysis on user pain points.
归因分析：attribution analysis
这些都需要串联咬合，才能形成最终的打法。
All of this must interlock to form the final playbook.
串联咬合：interlock
paraphrase: 词越高级，越说不清做什么
Packing a simple ask into an epic project.
scenes.speak: Offline events and online promotion must align on goals; every department needs to share information and strengthen collaboration. The top-level design zeroes in on the user's perception track; the underlying logic runs attribution analysis on user pain points. All of this must interlock to form the final playbook.

scenes.context: 黑话包装后的方案张口就要100万预算，老板当场说算了。
sentences: 所以这个宣传方案大概需要投入100万预算才行。
So this promotion plan is going to need about a million in budget.
预算：budget
要这么多钱啊？那还是算了吧。
That much money? Then let's just drop it.
还是算了吧：let's just drop it
怎么样，你悟了吗？学会黑话就能秒杀你的同事。
Get it now? Master the jargon and you'll outshine your colleagues.
秒杀同事：outshine your colleagues
paraphrase: 黑话没换来认可，换来一句算了
Jargon bought no approval — just a 'never mind.'
scenes.speak: So this promotion plan is going to need about a million in budget. That much money? Then let's just drop it. Get it now? Master the jargon and you'll outshine your colleagues.

practice: We need to share information across departments.
That's how we form the final playbook.
My manager said let's just drop it.
pitfalls: ✓ 地道说法：Share information across teams.
拉通是中文黑话，英文用 share / sync up。
✕ 直译腔：Form the final fighting method.
✓ 地道说法：That forms the final playbook.
打法在商务英文里用 playbook / strategy。
秒杀→比同事出彩，用 outshine。
✓ 地道说法：A viral information push.
信息爆破→引爆传播，用 viral / go viral。
shifts: 用清晰目标和成本争取预算
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「大工人」校正为「大厂人」、「岌时不然」校正为「实则不然」、「保洁公司」按语境保留（P&G 中文名）、「垂直理念」校正为「垂直布局」、「传播举证」校正为「传播矩阵」、「复能」校正为「赋能」、「不明角力」校正为「不明觉厉」。
